expected_facts.text: All seven supplied artifacts are accounted for; the first representative slice is not a completion boundary.

The Java boundary delegates request type routing to RequestService, so direct equivalence is not proven from the supplied Java source.
POST /requests exposes submitRequest with 202 and 400 responses.
Runtime configuration defines timeout, retry, and audit controls.
Requirements, complexity, estimation, roadmap, and dashboard outputs remain evidence-linked.
